messages:
sam (Support): Heads-up: Customer ACME asked for a Console view that shows per-model and per-route cost + latency hotspots, with a way to filter by customer ID and time range. They want to tie spikes to traces.
maya (PM): Thanks — can you paste the customer's exact ask and urgency? Is this a blocker for renewal?
sam (Support): Quote from AE: "We need a dashboard to prove to finance that LLM usage cost spikes were due to a model rollout — otherwise renewal is at risk." They asked for something before next quarter contract renewal (~3 weeks).
liam (Sales): Confirmed — high-touch enterprise. They need exportable views for finance and an ability to annotate rollouts. Not a hard blocker but VERY helpful for renewal conversation.
maya (PM): Ok. This maps to Observability initiative. Propose intake fields: use-case, acceptance criteria, data sources, expected retention window, and rollout plan. Anyone have quick AC suggestions?
anya (Eng - Observability): Technical constraints: we already surface per-route latency and token counts at 1m granularity. Missing pieces: model-level cost attribution (needs better token->model cost mapping), trace linking (sampling rate currently 0.1%), and UI filters for customer_id + route.
maya (PM): Draft ACs: 1) New Console dashboard with filters (customer_id, route, model, timeframe) that shows: cost-per-token by model, 95p latency heatmap, request count. 2) Link from a spike to sampled traces and the raw request listing. 3) CSV export of filtered view. 4) Data retention: 90 days. 5) Backfill: last 30 days on rollout.
sam (Support): Customer also asked for alerting on >2x baseline cost week-over-week per-customer. Should that be in scope?
maya (PM): Suggest we treat alerts as stretch scope. Core MVP = dashboard + trace link + export. Alerts = follow-up.
liam (Sales): Agree MVP is fine for renewal timeline if we can deliver a demo in ~3 weeks. If engineering needs more time, we should ask for a short extension.
anya (Eng - Observability): Implementation notes: need a nightly job to recompute model-attributed cost by request (cost per token * token_count by model), adjust trace sampling to 1% for customers on pilot (privacy check required), and add UI filters. Rough estimate: 3 sprints (2 engs + 1 frontend) for MVP, plus infra work for backfill.
maya (PM): Risks: data accuracy on model attribution (we have multi-model routing fallback cases), privacy/compliance for trace link, and perf of query if we keep 1m granularity.
sam (Support): I'll collect an example timeframe and sample request IDs from the customer to help validate attribution logic.
liam (Sales): I'll ask ACME for permission to enable higher trace sampling for their tenant for the pilot.
maya (PM): Decision: Move to triage as 'P1 (pilot for renewal)'. Maya will write brief PRD with AC and hand to Eng. Stretch: alerts and automated SLA reports.
anya (Eng - Observability): Noted. Can we add acceptance test: sample spike triggered by controlled rollout in staging and verify dashboard surfaces it + trace links?
maya (PM): Yes, add that to PRD.
sam (Support): +1. I'll update the support ticket with the plan and timelines. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New issue created: OBS-DASH-457 (mvp dashboard + trace linking)
maya (PM): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with PRD and schedule an intake review with Eng + Sales for Wednesday.
